result:
Clean — no lambdas, diamond operators, or underscored numeric literals. Both self-contained test classes compile and all 49 tests pass.

Created:
- `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/StringUtilsAgentTest.java` — covers empty/blank checks, trim/strip, equals, indexOf/contains, substring/left/right/mid, join/split, replace, case conversion, abbreviate (incl. `IllegalArgumentException` boundary), padding/repeat, defaults, startsWith/endsWith, countMatches, reverse/swapCase, is* character checks, Levenshtein distance (incl. threshold and null-arg error), ordinalIndexOf, chomp, center.
- `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/text/StrBuilderAgentTest.java` — covers constructors, append overloads (incl. null handling and `StringIndexOutOfBoundsException` boundaries), charAt/setCharAt bounds, clear/isEmpty, contains, delete family, startsWith/endsWith, indexOf/lastIndexOf, insert overloads and bounds, replace family, reverse/trim, length/size/capacity/setLength, ensureCapacity/minimizeCapacity, equals/hashCode (including an actual `NullPointerException` in `equalsIgnoreCase(null)`, contrary to its Javadoc), substring/left/right/mid strings, toCharArray/getChars, fixed-width padding, separators, CharSequence methods, `asReader`/`asWriter`/`asTokenizer`, `readFrom`, and fluent chaining.
